propositions: Step-budget exhaustion diagnostic (repetition counters) is computed in interpret_failure but dropped before reaching gate_error_v1 sidecar emission because _bounded_diagnostic allowlist strips the keys

Without the diagnostic sidecar, operators cannot distinguish looping (excessive tool call repetition) from genuine budget exhaustion, leading to manual budget escalations that do not fix the underlying constraint violation

The allowlist in _bounded_diagnostic and merge() guard must be widened to pass tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, and distinct_ratio_window through to raise_completion_workflow_failure

raise_completion_workflow_failure must render the aggregate_*-prefixed diagnostic keys through format_repetition and include concrete repetition counts (e.g. '30 distinct / 253 calls') in the operator-facing error message

Complete carry path requires keys to survive both recovery-exception merge (via fd84) and primary-exception merge (with aggregate_ prefix), then be de-prefixed before rendering so format_repetition field lookups resolve correctly
